summary: Aperture AC, a Cayman-incorporated Nasdaq-listed blank-check company (APUR/APURR), filed an 8-K disclosing a September 10, 2026 Business Combination Agreement with Atlantic HPC Group Inc. The SPAC will domesticate into Delaware, then merge its wholly owned subsidiary into Atlantic, which survives. Atlantic equityholders receive SPAC common stock with aggregate value of $150,000,000, each share valued at $10.00, implying 15 million shares. Aperture Sponsor LLC acts as SPAC representative and AHPC Holding LLC as seller representative. A definitive proxy/prospectus, Nasdaq listing, redemptions and closing conditions are the key mechanics to watch; redemption levels will dictate remaining cash and dilution from any financing overhang.
